metadata.body:
Adds Java Cassandra conformance for the stable database semantic conventions. The database runner now starts a pinned Cassandra 5.0.9 container and runs simple queries, prepared statements, logged batches, and server-reported query errors against driver 3.11.5, driver 4.3.1, and Apache driver 4.19.3.

The Java agent covers all three driver lines. The published `opentelemetry-cassandra-4.4` library instrumentation runs against Apache driver 4.19.3. Earlier driver lines remain agent-only because OpenTelemetry does not publish standalone instrumentation for them.

Scenario contracts can now declare `allowed_metrics` alongside required `metrics`. Cassandra uses this to require `db.client.operation.duration` while accepting optional Java SDK and exporter self-metrics.
metadata.title: Add Java Cassandra database conformance
